title: {{NAME}} and the Lost Fairy Lights
moral: Small acts of kindness can light up the whole world.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was visiting the Fairy Kingdom. The Fairy Kingdom had tall mushroom houses and tiny bright lights. Every night the fairies lit up the sky with magic lights. But tonight the sky was dark and empty. A princess named Rose stood by the mushroom gate. She wore a deep blue dress and held a lantern. The fairies had lost all their lights.

pages.content: Princess Rose told {{NAME}} the story. The fairy lights had rolled into the deep dark Wishing Well. Nobody dared go near it. Then a silver unicorn stepped out from behind a mushroom house. She had a glowing rose-gold horn and a white mane. "I know the well," said the unicorn softly. "I will show you the way."

pages.content: The unicorn led them to the Wishing Well. Her rose-gold horn shone like a torch. {{NAME}} leaned over the edge. He could see dozens of tiny lights glowing at the bottom. He took a deep breath. He reached down carefully and scooped them all up. The lights burst into the air and flew back to the fairies.

pages.content: The fairies caught their lights. They flew up high and filled the whole sky with colour. Pink and gold and blue lights danced above the Kingdom. Princess Rose gasped. It was the most beautiful thing anyone had seen. Small acts of kindness can light up the whole world. The fairies all called {{NAME}}'s name with cheers.

pages.content: The fairies hung a special light above {{NAME}}'s head. It glowed soft and warm and pink. Princess Rose made warm berry cakes. The unicorn hummed a quiet song. Small acts of kindness can light up the whole world. {{NAME}} felt cosy and warm and sleepy. He closed his eyes with a big smile. He wondered if one of those fairy lights was made just for him.
